uncited: This method extends the standard differentiable Gaussian rasterizer to simultaneously output color, depth, and geometric auxiliary maps (such as normals or albedo) per pixel.

It solves the problem of extracting dense geometric information from 3D Gaussian splats by treating depth and geometric attributes as additional channels in the alpha-compositing accumulation, allowing gradients to flow back to the 3D Gaussian parameters for geometry-aware training.
It differs from standard color-only rasterization by maintaining and backpropagating through additional output tensors (`out_all_map`, `out_plane_depth`) alongside the color buffer.
The method operates in two phases: a forward pass that projects 3D Gaussians and accumulates color, depth, and geometric maps, and a backward pass that computes gradients for all Gaussian parameters.
- `raster_settings.tanfovx`, `raster_settings.tanfovy`: Tangent of horizontal/vertical field of view.
- `raster_settings.image_height`, `raster_settings.image_width`: Output image dimensions.
- `geomBuffer`, `num_rendered`, `binningBuffer`, `imgBuffer`: Intermediate buffers from forward pass.
- Gradients for: `means3D`, `means2D`, `means2D_abs`, `sh`, `colors_precomp`, `opacities`, `scales`, `rotations`, `cov3Ds_precomp`, `gard_all_map`.
The implementation relies on a C++/CUDA backend (`_C.rasterize_gaussians`).
